name: personalnotes
description: Personal Notes OSS core: headless notes service (HTTP API primary + CLI + MCP + generated SDK) with dual SQLite/Postgres storage and a multi-tenancy backend. Deployment modes local, self-hosted, and cloud; self-hosted runs personalnotes-serve against operator-owned Postgres with API-key auth.

serviceSurfaces.name: http
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The HTTP API/serve, CLI, MCP, and SDK surface implementations are delivered by the sibling api/cli/mcp/sdk workstreams; this contracts workstream establishes the manifest and the check:contracts conformance gate.

readinessGates.summary: Protected /v1 routes must fail closed without a valid tenant-bound API key (asserted by the api workstream).
SQLite default plus operator Postgres via HASNA_PERSONALNOTES_DATABASE_URL, proven by the env-gated live-PG suite (asserted by the storage workstream).

contractsGapSpec.note: hosting, storage.engines, and per-surface kind (including sdk) are recorded under metadata because @hasna/contracts 0.5.2 uses a strict schema that does not yet host them as first-class fields. Promote to top-level fields once the hasna-contracts-gap-spec schema vNext lands. See knowledge hasna-contracts-gap-spec.

metadata.publicManifestPolicy: Public OSS manifest: storage capability is expressed via engines[] plus envPrefix only. Concrete database credential references stay private-tier (platform control-plane config, infra terraform, and the deploy SSM manifest); they never appear in this public repo.
